pages.title: Gas Centrifuge Cascade
pages.text: Rotors spinning faster than sound fling the heavier isotope outward. One stage enriches a little; a tower of them, a lot. Build it taller for more stages: each new layer on top is one more.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

A tower of stages: build the stage layer (four rotors behind windows) once, or stack it up to fourteen high - every stage multiplies the U-235 ratio by β. It also makes uranium hexafluoride, fuel salt, and takes spent salt apart again (fluoride volatility). Enrichment is interlocked at 20%.

pages.name: Gas Centrifuge Cascade
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Fission Fragment Mix, Lithium-6 Ingot, Molten Salt Fuel, Plutonium-239 Pellet, Rare Earth Oxide, Uranium Hexafluoride, Uranium-235 Pellet, Uranium-238 Pellet.
